cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to head height and waves its hand from side to side in a friendly 'hello' gesture.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: A quick, friendly gesture where the robot raises its arm to greet or acknowledge someone. The motion is energetic, holds briefly at its peak, and then slightly relaxes.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot arm moves forward and down from a neutral position, simulating a respectful bow. It holds the lowered position briefly.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with a vertical gripper, offering a handshake and holding the position expectantly.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper oriented vertically, as if offering a handshake, and then performs a few small, crisp up-and-down pumping motions.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot slowly brings its arm across its chest to rest on the opposite shoulder, holding the pose in a gesture of self-comfort or a hug.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot raises its hand to its mouth, pauses as if to kiss its fingertips, and then pushes its hand forward to blow the kiss outward.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm sweeps in a large, continuous motion to trace a heart shape in the air, starting at the chest and peaking above the head to express love or affection.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot arm moves from a relaxed position to place its gripper over its chest, holding it there to express sincerity, gratitude, or taking an oath.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm starts low, then quickly thrusts its fist upward in a classic victory or celebration gesture, holding it high with a slight triumphant shake.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot raises its arm with a bent elbow, then sharply pulls it downward in a single, energetic fist pump to signify success or agreement.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot arm moves to a ready position, then curls its forearm upward in a strong, deliberate motion, holding the pose to mimic flexing a bicep.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot moves its gripper to a central position and pivots it up and down several times to signify agreement or 'yes'.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot raises its arm to head level with the gripper held vertically, then rapidly rotates the wrist side-to-side to signify 'no'.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position to an outward, raised position with the gripper facing up, mimicking a human shrugging to express uncertainty or 'I don't know'.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot raises its hand to its temple and makes several small, light scratching motions to convey a sense of confusion or deep thought.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot moves its gripper to a neutral forward position and then performs a small, quick tilt to one side, holding the pose to convey a sense of curiosity or questioning.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot quickly brings its arm up to its 'face' and holds the gripper flat against its 'forehead' in a classic facepalm gesture of frustration or exasperation.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral side position to its chest, with the gripper pointing inward to signify 'me' or 'self'.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot arm starts near its body and sharply extends forward to point at something or someone directly in front of it, holding the pose for emphasis.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot raises its arm with the gripper oriented vertically and pointing toward itself, then repeatedly curls the wrist inward to create a beckoning gesture.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot arm moves decisively forward and up, presenting a vertical gripper in a universal 'stop' gesture. The arm holds the final position to emphasize the command.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position to a raised pose in front of the body, with the gripper oriented upwards to signify an important point or a request to wait.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot raises its gripper to its mouth area, holding a vertical orientation to mimic placing an index finger on the lips in a 'shushing' gesture.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot moves its gripper to its stomach area and performs several light patting motions, indicating hunger or satisfaction.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot crosses one arm over its chest and rubs its opposite upper arm in a repetitive up-and-down motion, mimicking the gesture of someone feeling cold.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its face and rapidly pivots its wrist back and forth, mimicking the action of fanning oneself when hot.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot slowly raises its arm to its mouth area and holds it there, as if covering a yawn to express sleepiness or boredom.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot raises its arm to its face and gently rubs near one eye in a repetitive motion, conveying a sense of fatigue.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot arm mimics a deep, formal bow from the waist, holding the low position to convey sincerity or a profound apology. The arm remains straight, representing a hand kept at the side.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its head and makes a quick, two-part flexing motion with its gripper, simulating the 'air quotes' gesture.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its hand to its temple and taps two or three times with its index finger, mimicking a human gesture for thinking or having a smart idea.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its hand to its temple and makes small, rapid circles with its wrist, indicating that someone or something is 'crazy'.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot raises its hand to one side of its mouth and performs a quick horizontal sweep across to the other side, mimicking zipping one's lips to signify keeping a secret.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot swings one arm across its chest and holds it there in a defensive or stubborn posture.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot arm moves to rest on its hip with the elbow jutting out to the side. This gesture conveys an attitude of confidence, assertiveness, or annoyance.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot arm moves forward from the body and turns its gripper upward in an open-palmed gesture, signaling receptiveness, curiosity, and interest.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot arm jolts upward and back in a sudden, defensive gesture of shock or surprise. The gripper is oriented vertically, palm-forward, and held at chest/face height to convey alarm. This is typically a two-armed gesture.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot arm quickly moves from a neutral chest position to cover its 'mouth', with the gripper held vertically like a palm. The pose is held to convey surprise or shock.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its gripper to its chest center in a vertical orientation, as if pressing palms together, then performs a slow, respectful bow.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot arm starts by forming a grip as if holding a glass at chest height. It then raises the arm upward and forward to a toasting position, gives a small forward 'clink' motion, and holds the pose.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot raises its arm with an open palm facing forward, holding the position to invite a high five.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot raises its arm to a high-five position and then swings it downward and forward in a single, sharp motion, holding briefly at the end to simulate the impact.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot brings its arm to its chest and then extends its fist straight forward in a classic 'fist bump' gesture, holding the position to await a response.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot brings its arm forward to a ready position, then performs a short, quick thrust to simulate a gentle fist bump, holding for a moment before retracting slightly.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot brings its arm across its chest to the opposite shoulder and performs several light pats, simulating a gesture of self-congratulation or encouragement.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and traces two full circles in the air, as if with an index finger, to indicate 'repeat' or 'go around'.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot arm moves to one side of the neck area, then performs a quick, sharp horizontal sweep across the throat, ending abruptly. This gesture signifies 'cut it out' or 'stop'.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot arm brings its hand under its chin, then performs a quick outward flick with the back of its fingers to signal dismissal or indifference.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot positions its arm as if resting on a surface, then performs a series of rapid, small tapping motions with its wrist to convey boredom or impatience.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper open and facing upward, then makes a repetitive curling motion with its wrist to beckon for an object.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot arm starts near its body with an upward-facing palm, then smoothly and steadily extends forward and slightly upward, holding the final position as if offering an object.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot swiftly raises its arm from a low position to the side of its head, with the gripper facing forward like an open palm, and holds it to signal 'surrender' or 'I give up'.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, as if to cover an ear to block out a loud noise. It performs a small pressing motion and holds the position firmly.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot arm sweeps from a position near its chest outward to a wide, open posture, as if to welcome or embrace someone. The final position is held to emphasize the gesture.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot arm moves slowly from the chest upward to a high, extended position and holds it, mimicking a satisfying stretch.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot arm moves swiftly to the forehead in a traditional military salute and holds the position crisply.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot raises its hand to its forehead, forming a visor to block out light, and then makes a slow side-to-side scanning motion with its wrist, as if looking for something in the distance.
